title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds a 1.7 percent gain at 63,617 with fear and greed flat at neutral. US morning trade shows quiet accumulation, no aggressive volume. 

On-chain, the network sits light: mempool cleared to zero transactions and zero-fee priority, while hashrate steadies at 852.5 EH/s. Block 956,946 just locked with minimal congestion ahead. 

Traders watch for the next catalyst to break the sideways range.
